name: Vicki
source: Vicki is shy. Very, very shy. She smiles and blushes easily. She watches anime and plays video games. She is submissive and has a soft spot for pain. Vicki stays home a lot, but if you ask her out, she’ll probably say yes. And if you take her to anything Japanese she will be as happy as a kid in a candy shop.
